needs.description: My H-1B was not selected in the lottery and my grace period is running out. I need to understand my options (O-1, cap-exempt, change of status) fast.
Going through an uncontested divorce with shared custody of two kids. Looking for someone to handle the paperwork and mediation.
Rear-ended at a red light, ongoing back pain and physical therapy. The other driver's insurer is lowballing the settlement.
Affirmative asylum applicant with an interview scheduled next month. I need help preparing my declaration and evidence.
I was laid off while on H-1B and believe it was retaliation after I reported safety issues. Worried about both the wrongful termination and my status.
Two co-founders starting a SaaS company. Need help with incorporation, a founder agreement, and a SAFE for our first angel investor.
First-time DUI arrest, arraignment is in a few days. Concerned about how a conviction could affect my green card renewal.
Landlord is withholding my security deposit and claiming damages I didn't cause. I have photos and a move-out checklist.
Need a will and a living trust. Some assets are overseas, so I want someone familiar with cross-border inheritance.
Bootstrapped app startup. Someone is using a confusingly similar name and logo. I want to register my trademark and send a cease-and-desist.
Overwhelmed by credit-card and medical debt after a job loss. Trying to figure out if Chapter 7 is the right move for me.
On F-1 OPT and recently married a U.S. citizen. We want to file for a marriage-based green card and need help avoiding common mistakes.
My employer is misclassifying me as a contractor and not paying overtime. I have time records going back a year.
Need an emergency custody modification — my ex is planning to relocate out of state with our child without my consent.
My elderly mother is visiting on a B-2 and had a medical emergency. We may need to extend her stay and understand the implications.
Dispute with a vendor who breached a six-figure services contract. Want to understand whether to negotiate or pursue litigation.

pitches.message: H-1B not selected is stressful but you have real options. I've moved dozens of clients to O-1 or cap-exempt roles within the grace period. Happy to map out a timeline on a quick call.
If you recently married a citizen, a marriage-based green card may also bridge your status. Let's review which path fits your timeline and budget before the grace period ends.
Uncontested divorces with shared custody are exactly what I handle daily. I offer flat-fee mediation so there are no surprises, and we can do most of it remotely.
Insurers always start low. With ongoing PT and documented back injury, your case is worth pursuing. No fee unless we recover — I only get paid when you do.
Interview prep is where affirmative asylum cases are won or lost. I'll help you build a clear declaration and organize country-condition evidence. I offer a sliding scale.
This is two problems at once — a potential retaliation claim and your H-1B status. I handle both. Let's preserve your evidence now and discuss a 60-day plan to protect your status.
I've set up many SaaS startups. I can deliver incorporation, a founder agreement, and a clean SAFE as a flat package so you can focus on the raise.
As a former prosecutor I know how these DUI cases are charged. For green-card holders the immigration consequences matter as much as the criminal outcome — we'll address both.
With photos and a move-out checklist, you're in a strong position on the deposit. Florida law has specific deadlines landlords must meet — let's send a demand that cites them.
Cross-border estates need careful drafting to avoid double taxation and probate abroad. I'll prepare a will and living trust that account for your overseas assets.
First step is securing your trademark filing date, then a cease-and-desist carries far more weight. I can do both quickly and explain the enforcement options.
F-1 OPT to marriage green card is a path I handle constantly. The biggest risks are timing and the medical exam — I'll give you a checklist so nothing gets missed.
